name: TVmaze API
summary: Keyless TV database: shows, episodes, cast, schedules and people.
description: Search and lookup of TV shows with genres, status, runtime, network, ratings, episodes, seasons, cast and crew, and daily schedules by country. Cross-references to IMDb, TheTVDB and TV Rage IDs via lookup. An updates endpoint supports syncing.

auth.notes: A premium plan exists, but only for user-specific endpoints.

rate_limit.summary: At least 20 calls per 10 seconds per IP (documented); HTTP 429 if exceeded.

endpoints.summary: Look up a show by external ID

coverage.temporal: Community edits in real time; schedules daily

agent_notes: Use /lookup/shows with imdb, thetvdb or tvrage to map external IDs to TVmaze IDs, then /shows/{id}?embed=episodes to fetch episodes in one call. Attribute TVmaze for text and images.
caveats: Attribution to TVmaze is required for images and text.
